content:
Manchester City won the most recent Champions League final, defeating Inter Milan 1-0 on June 10, 2023, in Istanbul. Rodri scored the winning goal for City, giving them their first Champions League title.

Note: If you're asking about the 2023-24 season, that final hasn't been played yet - it's scheduled for June 1, 2024, at Wembley Stadium in London.
